The build of the engine at `319075e3f92b`: its CMake options, its presets, its CTest tests with their labels and how the unit tests are split into shards.

## CMake options

| `STRATA_BUILD_EDITOR` | `ON` | Build the Strata editor | `CMakeLists.txt:19` |
| `STRATA_BUILD_RUNTIME` | `ON` | Build the Strata runtime (game player used for exported games) | `CMakeLists.txt:20` |

## Shards

How CTest runs the StrataTests suites: the suites of their own CTests (OwnTests, each running the suites its Suites filters match and its Exclude filters do not), then StrataTests.Core in shards, one CTest StrataTests.Core.&lt;Name&gt; (label core) per shard, running the suites its Suites filters match and its Exclude filters do not (doctest filters: \* and ? wildcards, case-insensitive). Every suite runs in exactly one shard or own CTest; Testing.Shards fails naming the suites in none or in two, so a new suite prefix gets a shard here, and naming the test cases outside any TEST\_SUITE, which no shard runs. Suites ending in .Sweep run a sample of their corruption sweep in their shard and the whole sweep again in StrataTests.Fuzz (FuzzSuites, Release and Dist). Keep each shard under about 60 s in Debug.
